tool.title: Candidate translations — agent model
tool.description: An agent model proposes a translation for each string of a catalogue, with the locale term base and the string's source context in front of it, and appends them to the catalogue's candidates sidecar with `source.kind: agent` and the model's id. Seeds an empty `msgstr` with the first candidate, fuzzy.

inputs.name: catalogue
inputs.description: The `.po` catalogue to propose translations for.

outputs.name: candidates
outputs.description: `<locale>/<catalogue>.candidates.json` (`translation-candidates/v1`), appended to; and the `.po`, where an empty `msgstr` now holds the first candidate marked `#, fuzzy`.

selection.when: Prose that needs the surrounding meaning — paragraphs, diagram labels whose sense depends on the process, terms the locale term base fixes — and when an agent session is already running.
selection.limits: Not reproducible run to run, and the model's output is as unreviewed as any engine's. For a large catalogue of short, literal strings, `translation-candidates-opus-mt` is cheaper and repeatable; with no model at all, `translation-candidates-libretranslate`.
selection.cost: Model tokens per string, in a session that has a model; nothing to install.

$comment.comment: `manual` for now: the engine script is being built in cat-harness-tools, and `check:tools` refuses a `bun run cat <key>` that no layer declares. When its checkout-script key lands, `invoke.shell` names it and `manual` goes.
The agent is the session already running; it reaches no host this Tool adds.
